forms.name: Application for Permit to Operate a Pipeline in Texas

explanations.trigger_explanation: New or modified intrastate transmission, gathering, or other Railroad Commission of Texas-regulated pipeline facilities commonly require a T-4 permit to operate in Texas.

known_unknowns: Distribution lines and some production or flow lines are excluded from the T-4 pathway and should be confirmed with the Railroad Commission of Texas.
advisories: Additional review recommended to confirm whether the facility is intrastate, gathering, transmission, production, flow, or distribution before assigning a T-4 requirement.
notes: Confidence tier 2 because official Railroad Commission of Texas pages clearly support the permit process, but project applicability depends on line classification and exclusions.
